headline: Central Bank of Nigeria Conducts N90 Trillion OMO Liquidity Mop-Up
summary: The Central Bank of Nigeria drained over N90 trillion in excess banking sector liquidity through Open Market Operations over eleven months, up from N40.9 trillion in 2025.
why: Open Market Operations are central bank tools used to manage commercial bank reserve liquidity, control structural inflation, and stabilize domestic money supply growth.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: Aggressive central bank liquidity mopping tightens interbank borrowing conditions.
